name: fal
description: Get the best out of fal.ai models: research each model's official guides into prompt templates and input rules, generate through them, chain outputs, and design multi-model workflows packaged as skills. Bundles the fal MCP server for model discovery.

fal_api_key.title: fal API key (for the fal MCP server)
fal_api_key.description: Used only by the bundled fal MCP server for model discovery (recommend_model, search_models…). Create one at https://fal.ai/dashboard/keys. The skill itself reads FAL_KEY or Bitwarden, not this value. Leave empty to skip the MCP server.
